# Determine and review worker status

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Separately reviewed employment-rights and tax-status determinations with approved engagement changes and a reassessment record.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source checked on 2026-11-01. No case-specific legal review, independent professional assurance or completed execution is claimed. Sources establish regional entry points; determine the actual applicable local route with qualified reviewers.

## Outcomes

- Separately reviewed employment-rights and tax-status determinations with approved engagement changes and a reassessment record.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Record the real working arrangement

agent-runnable


Collect the engaging entity, worker and work locations, intermediary, proposed duties, supervision, substitution, equipment, payment and actual working practices. Use private evidence from both parties; a contract label alone is insufficient input for a status decision.

- Sources: [GOV.UK employment status](https://www.gov.uk/employment-status)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Review employment and tax status separately

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


Appropriately qualified employment and tax reviewers assess the relationship under the applicable local tests, recording their reasoning and unresolved facts. Employment-rights status and tax status may differ; agency, intermediary, overseas and disputed cases need the relevant specialist route.

- Sources: [GOV.UK employment status](https://www.gov.uk/employment-status)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the engagement and correction plan

agent-runnable


Translate the reviewed determinations into proposed contract, onboarding, payroll, benefits and record changes. Identify historical arrangements needing correction and list affected owners without treating a draft contract as proof of the actual relationship.

- Sources: [GOV.UK employment status](https://www.gov.uk/employment-status)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the determination and engagement route

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


The accountable people owner approves the specific engagement or remediation plan after required employment and tax review. Resolve material factual disputes or missing locations before onboarding; retain the decision and its stated assumptions.

- Sources: [GOV.UK employment status](https://www.gov.uk/employment-status)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Implement the authorized engagement changes

human · human approval every run · hard to undo


Authorized people complete the approved contracts, payroll or supplier setup and required communications in private systems. Retain signed records and implementation evidence, and assign disputed status or historical corrections to the qualified owner.

- Sources: [GOV.UK employment status](https://www.gov.uk/employment-status)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Verify actual practices and schedule reassessment

agent-runnable


Check that working practices and operating records reflect the approved arrangement. Record changes to location, control, duties or intermediary and reopen the assessment when assumptions change; preserve the separate employment and tax reasoning.

- Verify: Separately reviewed employment-rights and tax-status determinations with approved engagement changes and a reassessment record.
- Sources: [GOV.UK employment status](https://www.gov.uk/employment-status)
